notes.title: Full Release Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Conscience has recently been updated and is no longer in early access! 

I've been reading all the feedback and bugs you guys have provided, and have taken it into account for this update.

The main changes are the following:
[list]
[*] Updated Interior & Exteriors
[*] Clue locations have been tweaked
[*] Items now have a slight "shininess" for increased visibility
[*] Ability to delete saves
[*] Minor adjustment to game ending
[*] Grammatical fixes
[*] Bug fixes (including the clue counter overflowing)
[*] And some other smaller tweaks
[/list]

I truly appreciate all the kind reviews (and the negative ones as well), as they encourage me immensely.

Regarding the future of Conscience... there MIGHT be a couple of small updates coming in the future alongside potentially adding controller and Steam Deck support.

But for the time being I'm going to begin working on new projects...

And thank you all again for playing!
